method: Direct visual inspection of image_gen outputs and canonical comparisons; no OCR or semantic detector.

selected_a.readability: Large short names and pictograms; miniature text not guaranteed.
selected_a.geometry: Lower board/rail heights and lower empty bay differ from guide.

selected_b.readability: Large names and pictograms visible at canonical size.
selected_b.geometry: Lower rail positions and lower empty bay differ from guide.

excluded_rounds.a_geometry: 4 stocked rows but silhouette width -24px (6.59%) after uniform fitting; original A retains closer overall width.
excluded_rounds.b_geometry: Only 3 stocked rows, lowest board empty: reject as FULL, despite silhouette width delta 0px.
excluded_rounds.b_four_rows: Explicit four-row instruction still resulted in only 3 stocked rows: rejected; retain original B with 4 stocked rows.

geometry_gate: NOT_PASSED_STRICT: canvas dimensions pass, but generated shelf landmarks, rail heights and world anchor are not an exact canonical match. Hough angles and silhouette bbox are diagnostics, not proof of calibrated projection.
transparency_note: Raw alpha preserved. Faint edge/void artifacts may remain; opaque checkerboard was not painted into sprites.
